commands.init: Create example workspace without overwriting files
commands.check: Validate current source; no index required
commands.index: Validate and atomically update indexed snapshot; --rebuild forces all documents
commands.query sql: Read-only SQLite SELECT with whitelisted functions; maximum 1000 rows
commands.graph: incoming|outgoing ID --depth 0..32; IDs must resolve uniquely or use document path
commands.extract: Original indexed Markdown by section ID: relative/path.md#anchor

exitCodes.1: check has errors, or warnings with --warnings-as-errors

span.positions: one-based lines and Unicode scalar columns

diagnostic.shacl: Optional structured SHACL report on evaluated violations: focusNode, constraintComponent, resultSeverity, sourceShape, resultPath, value, messages, sourceField (RFC 6901 pointer); absent on local/operational diagnostics
jsonl: One compact versioned result envelope per command invocation, not one row per line
snapshot: query, graph, search and extract read the last successful index operation; run index explicitly after edits
stdout: Only result data in JSON/JSONL; operational failures are JSON envelopes. clap usage errors/help use its standard streams.
